title: Settings must ignore Object.prototype values
prompt: `app.get(setting)`, `app.enabled()` and `app.disabled()` read inherited values from `Object.prototype`, so settings named like built-in properties (for example `constructor` or `hasOwnProperty`) look set. Only the app's own settings, and those inherited from a parent app, should count.

config .enabled() should default to false for prototype values
config .get() should return undefined for prototype values
config .set() should return undefined for prototype values
pass_to_pass: config .disable() should set prototype values
